proof: For every fixed finite real M and proper noncircular confocal elliptic pair of physical least period N≡2 mod 4, the signed area of the outer boundary-tangent polygon times the signed area of its feet from M is constant. Coprime star windings, reversed traversal and zero or negative signed pedal area are covered.

The connected genus-one flag curve has the standard finite translation T. The real circle isometry argument identifies central inversion with T^(N/2). The original area on the unramified cyclic quotient has at most two simple poles at infinity and must have exactly two by reversal and positivity. The pedal foot map is finite at original infinities and otherwise can have only isotropic finite contact poles.

The arithmetic congruence 2k≡1−N/2 moves all potential foot poles onto the original area orbits. Their only adjacent pairs share parallel residues, so the square-order terms vanish. Riemann–Roch and odd reversal give B_M=c_M A in that same pole space without dividing by an area. The older outer/original product follows here also by disjoint simple poles and complementary reversal zeros, completing the result.

The radial signed area identity is classical Steiner geometry. The explicit hexagon formula and doubled-triangle example are also present in Ferudun. The repeated triangles distinguish physical least period from list length; neither the arbitrary-point theorem nor the centered adjacent theorem claims the same period classes.
